field_contracts.adapter_registry: registry entries declare adapter id, capability, package/import names, fixture key, output schema, and no-live-import default without importing dependencies
field_contracts.dependency_gate: dependency gates evaluate package, credential, and network availability into ok or skipped status without side effects
field_contracts.result_envelope: result envelopes carry status, capability, fixture key, data, metadata, and skip reason in a stable provider-free shape
field_contracts.version_metadata: version metadata is fixture-sourced or unknown when dependencies are absent and never imports packages to inspect versions
field_contracts.terms_metadata: terms metadata records live-network prerequisites before any external call is allowed
field_contracts.credential_redaction: credential redaction records redacted field names and proves secret values are absent from outputs
field_contracts.no_live_import_default: no-live-import default prevents optional package imports during provider-free fixture replay
field_contracts.clean_skip: clean skips return skipped envelopes for absent package, absent credential, or disabled network states
